crucialFeats: Universe after universe has fallen before his might.
Turns DC Earth and everyone in it into stone.
Monitor ranks him on the same threat level as Spectre.
Destroys a planet with a glance.

dossier.advantage: Heart of Darkness and dark immortality. The condensed evil of a hundred galaxies grants him near-infinite magical resources and the ability to instantly regenerate.
dossier.mentality: A sadistic tyrant aiming for total conquest. He doesn't seek a challenge but revels in despair and the slow breaking of the opponent's spirit.
dossier.quote: In seeking to eradicate my evil... You have made me supreme! I am now power. I am now death. I am now TRIGON!
dossier.style: Static dominance and devastating energy projection. Trigon utilizes his six eyes for hellfire blasts and his divine brute force to effortlessly smash any opponent.

fighterA.name: Trigon

powers: Demonic energy projection, reality corruption, possession, conceptual regeneration, and dimensional travel.
tools: Realm shaping/control (demonic dimensions) and soul/matter pressure.
Heart of Darkness: artifact fueling his magic with the essence of billions of fallen souls.
weaknesses: Peak control is strongest inside favorable demonic environments.
Broad cosmic resistance of the opponent can slow his corruption tempo in neutral space.

crucialFeats: Possesses Ultimate Nullifier, a weapon that can destroy the entire universe.
Galactus must exist or the universe dies.
Galactus' attack encompasses three solar systems.
The whole universe was at risk of destruction when Galactus fought.
Sends Sphinx back in time to relive his life over and over.

dossier.advantage: Absolute power absorption and the Ultimate Nullifier. He can absorb energy directed against him and use the Nullifier to erase entire galaxies from existence.
dossier.mentality: A detached, eternally hungry force of nature. He perceives heroes and deities like insects or fuel, acting entirely outside the categories of good and evil.
dossier.quote: Of all the creatures in the vastness of the universe, there is none like me. I was present at the birth of the universe, and I shall be there at its end.
dossier.style: Direct Power Cosmic dominance. Galactus strikes with devastating energy blasts and uses molecular restructuring to turn opponents into pure energy.

fighterB.name: Galactus

powers: Power Cosmic, transmutation, large-scale energy projection, barriers, and matter control.
tools: Ultimate Nullifier: the final argument capable of resetting the entire universe.
weaknesses: In low-fed states, response speed and margin for error decrease.

battle-dynamics.phase_1: Galactus imposes cosmic scale. Power Cosmic normalizes the battlefield, giving Trigon no room for demonic corruption.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: Trigon attempts to break Galactus's barriers with hellfire, but the fed Devourer simply absorbs the energy as fuel.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: Galactus closes the fight with a massive Power Cosmic discharge. Trigon is pushed back to his dimension.
battle-dynamics.analysis: When Galactus is well-fed, his absorption capacity makes Trigon's magic ineffective.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_1: A weakened Galactus cannot keep up with Trigon's reality corruption pace. Infernal powers begin to poison the Power Cosmic.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_2: Trigon takes control of the space, turning it into his domain. Galactus loses structural stability.
battle-dynamics.s2_phase_3: Hunger prevents Galactus from defending effectively. Trigon wins by total corruption of the opponent's essence.
battle-dynamics.s2_analysis: A hungry Galactus loses his greatest asset – the margin for error.
battle-dynamics.s3_label: Fight to the Death · Fed Galactus
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_1: Trigon goes all out, releasing the Heart of Darkness. Galactus responds with full power, destroying surrounding star systems.
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_2: A clash of titans at the molecular level. Galactus begins deconstructing Trigon's body, ignoring his regeneration.
battle-dynamics.s3_phase_3: Galactus uses the Ultimate Nullifier (if necessary) or simply erases Trigon with pure cosmic energy.
battle-dynamics.s3_analysis: Under death rules, a fed Galactus is unstoppable for a being of Trigon's scale.
battle-dynamics.s4_label: Fight to the Death · Hungry Galactus
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_1: Trigon immediately strikes the weakest point – Galactus's hunger, draining his remaining energy.
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_2: Galactus desperately tries to absorb Trigon's energy, but it is too toxic for his weakened system.
battle-dynamics.s4_phase_3: Trigon ends the execution, tearing Galactus apart inside his demonic domain.
battle-dynamics.s4_analysis: The death of a hungry god. Trigon dominates every aspect of the clash.

fight-simulation.opening: Galactus opens the fight with a Power Cosmic wave that stabilizes the entire galaxy.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Trigon floods space with hellfire, but Galactus opens his mouth and literally drinks the attack.
fight-simulation.late_fight: Galactus strikes straight at Trigon's essence, casting him out of the universe's framework.
fight-simulation.end_condition: Galactus's victory through total energy dominance.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Galactus imposes his will on reality, extinguishing Trigon's first flames.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: Demonic magic clashes with cosmic technology. Galactus stands unmoved.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Trigon finds a gap in the barriers, but only for a moment.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Galactus begins absorbing the essence of Trigon's magic.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: Galactus releases a wave of energy that erases the demonic presence from the sector.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: Trigon is banished to his dimension.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_b: Trigon is scattered into pure information.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_1_event: Trigon floods the battlefield with blood-red energy, poisoning Galactus's source of power.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_event: A hungry Galactus weakens under the pressure of demonic will. His armor begins to corrode.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_2_branch_a: Galactus tries to counter with the Nullifier, but lacks the strength.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_event: Trigon performs a final gesture, turning Galactus into a stone monument to his glory.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_a: Galactus falls, becoming part of Trigon's domain.
fight-simulation.s2_phase_3_branch_b: Galactus flees into nothingness, losing his physical form.
fight-simulation.s2_end_condition: Trigon's victory through total corruption of the opponent.
fight-simulation.s3_label: Fight to the Death · Fed Galactus
fight-simulation.s3_phase_1_event: Galactus strikes with the intention of ending all life in sight.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_event: An exchange of blows that destroys entire galaxies in the background. Galactus is unyielding.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_branch_a: Trigon regenerates from the Heart of Darkness.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_2_branch_b: Galactus begins absorbing the Heart of Darkness itself.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_event: Galactus detonates his entire energy at one point, annihilating Trigon.
fight-simulation.s3_phase_3_branch_b: Both perish in the explosion, resetting the local universe.
fight-simulation.s4_label: Fight to the Death · Hungry Galactus
fight-simulation.s4_phase_1_event: Trigon tears the veil of reality, dragging a hungry Galactus into the heart of hell.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_event: Galactus is disassembled by demonic magic.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_2_branch_b: Galactus becomes a puppet in Trigon's hands.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_3_event: Trigon crushes Galactus's skull, ending the era of cosmic gods.
fight-simulation.s4_phase_3_branch_b: Trigon's victory over the universe's corpse.
fight-simulation.s4_end_condition: Trigon's dominance through absolute resource difference.

final-summary.line_1: Galactus possesses greater raw scale and destructive potential, but he is a slave to his own metabolism.
final-summary.line_2: Most clashes are won by Galactus, unless he is forced to fight in a state of extreme exhaustion and hunger.
final-summary.line_3: This is a duel of whether cosmic technology and Power Cosmic can survive in a world where demonic magic sets the rules.
final-summary.winner: Galactus (Fed) or Trigon (When Galactus is hungry).
final-summary.quote: “Gods eat planets, but demons eat gods.”

tactical-board.lane: Galactus must turn the battlefield into fuel before Trigon turns it into hell.
tactical-board.subtitle: Demon versus Devourer

verdict-matrix.case_1: Galactus 8.5/10. A fed devourer simply absorbs Trigon's magic and casts him out of reality.
verdict-matrix.case_2: Trigon 7/10. A hungry Galactus loses speed and resistance, allowing Trigon's corruption to take control.
verdict-matrix.case_3: Galactus 9.5/10. In a life-and-death struggle, a fed Galactus uses the Nullifier and ends the matter in a second.
verdict-matrix.case_4: Trigon 9/10. In an attrition fight, a hungry god stands no chance against a demon's infinite regeneration.

x-factor.implication: This is why the fight's outcome depends almost entirely on Galactus's saturation level at the start.
x-factor.mechanics: Galactus wins if he can metabolize Trigon's energy. Trigon wins if his magic is too 'heavy' to swallow.
x-factor.psychology: Trigon wants to prolong the fight to deepen Galactus's hunger. Galactus wants a swift finish.
x-factor.example: Trigon strikes Galactus with a soul wave. A fed Galactus laughs and converts the souls into energy for his armor. A hungry Galactus begins to scream in pain as the souls tear him apart from the inside.
x-factor.question: Will the Ultimate Nullifier work on a being that technically does not belong to this universe?
